_dailyRegularLimit_note: Daily Regular = MIN(Paid Hours, dailyRegularLimit); Daily OT = MAX(Paid Hours - dailyRegularLimit, 0).
_overtimeMultiplier_note: OT Rate = Hourly Rate x overtimeMultiplier.
_maxWeeklyPeriodDays_note: If the uploaded timesheet's earliest-to-latest date span exceeds this many days, generation is blocked with 'Timesheet contains more than one weekly period.' so two weeks can never accidentally get processed as one.
_jobClassifications_note: Read straight from the timesheet's own job codes (1/2/3), never from an employee name list. Each key is a keyword to search for (case-insensitive substring match) across an employee's job codes for the week. wcRate and excludeFromClubhouse are INDEPENDENT settings on the same classification -- per the team's actual SOP (Clubhouse_Calculation, confirmed against the Sep 14-20 2026 reference output), an employee whose job code contains 'Supervision' (e.g. Carlos Silva) gets ONLY the lower supervisor workers'-comp rate here; it does NOT remove them from Clubhouse billing. Clubhouse exclusion is decided solely by clubhouseExclusions below, a manual name list, not by job code.
_clubhouseTeamRoster_note: The SOP's actual first step: filter the weekly timesheet down to this named Clubhouse team before calculating anything. This roster -- not each employee's computed Clubhouse ratio -- decides who appears as a row in the NewClubhouse report sheet each week (so a roster member with 0% Clubhouse hours that week, e.g. Carlos Silva or Genesis Lopez some weeks, still shows a $0 row for audit continuity, exactly like the reference output). Anyone NOT on this list is out of scope for this report even if their job codes happen to touch Clubhouse/BluntD/Crysp. Maintain this list here as your team changes -- it is data, not application logic. If left empty, the app falls back to automatic detection (anyone with billable Clubhouse hours, a job classification, or a manual exclusion) as a reasonable default.
_clubhouseExclusions_note: Roster members whose payroll for this billing is calculated in a SEPARATE process and must NOT be included in this workbook's Clubhouse subtotal -- confirmed from the Sep 14-20 2026 reference output's own footnote ('Excluded total hours of Hazel Herrera, Elysia Castro and Paul Bates'). This is a manual, name-based list, independent of job classification -- Paul Bates has no 'Supervision' job code at all, and Hazel Herrera does, yet both are excluded purely because they're on this list.

employerTax._note: defaultRatePercent is the standard employer tax rule to use for any employee without an explicit override below. The per-employee overrides currently on file (Carlos Silva, Genesis Lopez, Paola Sanchez, Sylvia Lopez) are the EXACT figures reproduced by the Sep 14-20 2026 reference payroll output -- they are NOT guaranteed to be correct for future weeks. Before running a new week, replace these with the actual employer tax rate/source for that payroll run (the confirmed standard rate, or that week's Gusto/payroll-provider figures), or the future dollar amounts may be off by cents or more. If a rate is not supplied for an employee, generation is blocked rather than guessing.

workersComp._note: General labor gets defaultRate. Anyone whose job codes match a jobClassifications keyword above gets that classification's wcRate instead (independent of whether they're excluded from Clubhouse billing). overrides is a manual escape hatch for any other exception.
